beforeImage.name: Prince George's County Blueprint Schools Program (Phase One)
beforeImage.description: Prince George's County Blueprint Schools Program (Phase One) is a bundled public-private partnership for six public schools in Prince George's County, Maryland. Its end users are students, educators, and the county school system, with value supported by a long-term design-build-finance-maintain school concession rather than by private-pay revenue. The model is asset-heavy and availability-based, with private-sector responsibility for delivery and long-term maintenance. Public materials describe the phase as five middle schools and one K-8 school delivered under a 30-year contract, with more than 8,000 students benefiting from the new facilities. The reviewed materials did not disclose project-level revenue or the current project-company ownership percentages. Fengate-led Prince George's County Education and Community Partners reached commercial and financial close in 2021, opened five schools in 2023, and opened the sixth and final school in 2024.

milestones.event: Fengate-led Prince George's County Education and Community Partners achieved commercial and financial close on the six-school alternative construction financing project.
Fengate and its partners celebrated the opening of the first five schools in the bundle.
The sixth and final school, Colin L. Powell K-8 Academy, opened and completed Phase One.

afterImage.name: Prince George's County Blueprint Schools Program (Phase One)
aliases: Prince George's County Education & Community Partners, LLC
afterImage.description: Prince George's County Blueprint Schools Program (Phase One) is an availability-based DBFM concession covering six public schools in Prince George's County, Maryland through Prince George's County Education & Community Partners, LLC. The ProjectCo reached financial close on December 18, 2020 with Fengate-controlled entities holding 75% and Gilbane Development holding 25%. Five middle schools opened in August 2023 and Colin L. Powell K-8 Academy opened in November 2023; lifecycle and facilities-management services continue under a term ending June 30, 2053. BBGI acquired 100% from the Fengate and Gilbane vehicles in February 2026 and remains the current owner; BCI's ownership of BBGI is upstream and is not added as a separate ProjectCo owner. Phase Two is a distinct project. No later sale, concession termination or signed ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
